description: This Java source file defines a class 'IcsPaymentServices' that provides integration services for CyberSource payment gateway operations such as authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit. It includes methods to build request properties, handle responses, and encapsulate the payment transaction logic, including billing info, item info, and processing outcomes.

classes.name: IcsPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods to perform payment operations via CyberSource, such as authorization, capture, refund, release, and credit, building request parameters, processing responses, and handling configurations.

methods.name: buildCsProperties
methods.description: Constructs properties for the CyberSource client based on context and configuration, including merchant ID, key directory, API version, and logging options.

methods.name: buildAuthRequest
methods.description: Builds the request map for a payment authorization, including billing info, amount, currency, and optional capture settings.

methods.name: buildCaptureRequest
methods.description: Creates a capture request map referencing the prior authorization request, including capture amount and optional merchant descriptors.

methods.name: buildReleaseRequest
methods.description: Prepares a request to reverse (release) a prior authorization or capture.

methods.name: buildRefundRequest
methods.description: Prepares a refund request map referencing the original authorization transaction.

methods.name: buildCreditRequest
methods.description: Constructs a credit request to refund or credit a transaction identified by reference code.

methods.name: appendAvsRules
methods.description: Adds AVS decline rules to the request directives based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: appendFullBillingInfo
methods.description: Populates billing, shipping, and credit card info into the request map from the context.

methods.name: appendItemLineInfo
methods.description: Adds line item details and total amount info to the request for payment processing.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount to a string with configured scale and rounding mode.

methods.name: processAuthResult
methods.description: Interprets the response for an authorization request, updating the result map with status, codes, and messages.

methods.name: processCaptureResult
methods.description: Handles the transaction response for a capture request, setting success/failure and related info.

methods.name: processReleaseResult
methods.description: Handles response for releasing (voiding) a transaction.

methods.name: processRefundResult
methods.description: Processes the reply of a refund transaction to update the result map.

methods.name: processCreditResult
methods.description: Handles the result of a credit (refund) operation, updating success flag and details.

methods.name: getDecision
methods.description: Extracts the decision status (ACCEPT, reject, etc.) from the reply map.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Fetches configuration value for the CyberSource gateway, either from the database or from properties.
